entries.en: The queue moved dismayingly slowly, and we missed the last bus home.
entries.zh: 队伍前进得慢得令人沮丧，我们错过了回家的末班车。

entries.en: He dealt only glancingly with the budget before turning to the staffing problem.
entries.zh: 他只是粗略地谈了预算，便转而讨论人员配置问题。

entries.en: I had colossally underestimated how many boxes the move would require.
entries.zh: 我极大地低估了这次搬家需要多少个箱子。

entries.en: She remarked acerbically that his promises had arrived faster than his payment.
entries.zh: 她尖酸地说，他的承诺来得比付款快。

entries.en: We need to redivide the garden after selling the narrow strip beside the lane.
entries.zh: 卖掉小巷旁那条狭长地带后，我们需要重新划分花园。

entries.en: Her responsibilities expanded, but her salary did not rise commensurately.
entries.zh: 她的职责增加了，薪水却没有相应上涨。

entries.en: We had packed plenty of prog but forgotten every spoon and fork.
entries.zh: 我们带足了吃的，却把所有勺子和叉子都忘了。

entries.en: He replied waspishly when I asked whether he had checked the address.
entries.zh: 我问他是否核对过地址时，他气恼地作了回答。

entries.en: Sartorially, the plain black coat served her better than the glittering jacket.
entries.zh: 在穿着方面，那件朴素的黑大衣比闪闪发亮的夹克更适合她。

entries.en: They decided to retarget the advertising campaign at people buying their first bicycle.
entries.zh: 他们决定把广告活动的新目标对象定为首次购买自行车的人。

entries.en: The fictional cases looked similar but differed diagnostically once the full histories were available.
entries.zh: 这些虚构病例看起来相似，但完整病史齐备后，在诊断上却有所不同。

entries.en: In the war novel, the soldiers refuse to frag their own lieutenant.
entries.zh: 在这部战争小说中，士兵们拒绝蓄意杀伤自己的中尉。

entries.en: The detective discovered that someone had wiretapped the telephone in his empty office.
entries.zh: 侦探发现，有人搭线窃听了他那间空办公室里的电话。

entries.en: She prebaked the pastry case while I sliced the apples for the filling.
entries.zh: 我切做馅用的苹果时，她预先烘烤了酥皮饼壳。

entries.meaningZh: 在认识方面；与认识有关地
entries.en: Publishing that accusation without checking the available records was epistemically irresponsible.
entries.zh: 不核查现有记录就发表那项指控，在认识依据方面是不负责任的。

entries.en: My neighbour would humph at the price and then buy the newspaper anyway.
entries.zh: 我邻居总会对那个价格哼一声，但随后还是会买下报纸。

entries.en: The course helped him eat nutritiously without spending his whole evening cooking.
entries.zh: 这门课程帮助他吃得有营养，而不必花整个晚上做饭。

entries.en: With the vacuum cleaner running, it was easy to mishear the number she gave me.
entries.zh: 吸尘器开着，很容易听错她告诉我的号码。

entries.en: The council feared that the new fleet would overfish the bay.
entries.zh: 委员会担心新船队会对海湾中的鱼进行过度捕捞。

entries.en: Cracks in the hardscape made it difficult to push a wheelchair across the courtyard.
entries.zh: 硬景观上的裂缝让人难以推着轮椅穿过庭院。

entries.en: The film fictionally links the two families through a stolen painting.
entries.zh: 影片通过一幅被盗的画，虚构了两个家族之间的联系。

entries.en: The preacher defended the practice scripturally, but several listeners challenged his interpretation.
entries.zh: 那位传教士根据《圣经》为这种做法辩护，但几位听众质疑了他的解读。

entries.en: We disabled journaling on the test system to compare its recovery behaviour.
entries.zh: 我们关闭了测试系统的日志记录功能，以比较它的恢复表现。

entries.en: The program selected a route heuristically instead of checking every possible path.
entries.zh: 程序以启发式方法选择了一条路线，而没有检查每一条可能的路径。

entries.en: She was natively curious, taking apart broken toys long before she could read.
entries.zh: 她天生好奇，早在识字之前就会拆开坏掉的玩具。

entries.en: The detective reconstructed the visitor's movements inferentially from footprints and a wet umbrella.
entries.zh: 侦探根据脚印和一把湿雨伞，通过推理还原了来访者的行踪。

entries.en: I uninstalled the old drawing program after transferring my files to its replacement.
entries.zh: 把文件转移到替代软件后，我卸载了旧的绘图程序。

entries.en: Please renumber the tables after moving the two photographs into the appendix.
entries.zh: 请在把两张照片移入附录后，重新给表格编号。

entries.en: He arrived snappily dressed in a checked suit and polished brown shoes.
entries.zh: 他到场时穿着格子西装和擦亮的棕色鞋子，打扮得很时髦。

entries.en: The pavement was blisteringly hot, so we waited in the shade for the bus.
entries.zh: 人行道热得厉害，于是我们在阴凉处等公交车。

entries.meaningZh: 在圣经方面；与圣经相关地
entries.en: The teacher explained the passage biblically before discussing its influence on later poetry.
entries.zh: 老师先从《圣经》的角度解释了这段文字，再讨论它对后世诗歌的影响。

entries.en: The students contributed asynchronously, leaving comments whenever their work schedules allowed.
entries.zh: 学生们不同步参与，在工作安排允许时各自留下评论。

entries.en: The audience applauded thunderously when the young violinist returned for an encore.
entries.zh: 那位年轻小提琴手返场加演时，观众报以雷鸣般的掌声。

entries.en: A loose cover on the hammermill rattled whenever the motor started.
entries.zh: 每当电动机启动，锤磨机上一块松动的盖板就咔嗒作响。

entries.meaningZh: 埋怨；发牢骚〔苏格兰及英格兰方言〕
entries.en: You can pinge about the cold later; first, come inside and shut the door.
entries.zh: 你可以待会儿再抱怨冷；先到屋里来，把门关上。

entries.en: The uncuffed sleeves still needed finishing before the shirt could be delivered.
entries.zh: 这件衬衫尚未装袖口的袖子还需要加工，才能交货。

entries.en: The novel follows a missionary who tries to christianise the inhabitants of a fictional island.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位试图使虚构岛屿上的居民成为基督教徒的传教士的经历。

entries.en: The browser was prefetching the next page while I finished reading the current one.
entries.zh: 我读完当前页面时，浏览器正在预取下一页。

entries.en: The reengineering of the returns process eliminated two unnecessary approval stages.
entries.zh: 退货业务流程的再设计取消了两个不必要的审批环节。

entries.en: A damaged configuration file interrupted bootstrapping before the main application could start.
entries.zh: 一个损坏的配置文件中断了自举过程，主应用程序尚未来得及启动。

entries.en: The cabinet was stained interiorly but left unpainted on the outside.
entries.zh: 柜子内部上了色，外面却没有刷漆。

entries.en: The photographer chose to defocus the background rather than move the subject.
entries.zh: 摄影师选择让背景失焦，而没有移动拍摄对象。

entries.en: The application will prefetch the images before displaying the next set of cards.
entries.zh: 应用程序会先预取图像，再显示下一组卡片。

entries.en: The researcher photographed the explant beside a small ruler before recording its dimensions.
entries.zh: 研究人员拍下了一把小标尺旁的外植体，然后记录了它的尺寸。

entries.en: She sat prayerfully beside the chapel window while the others prepared to leave.
entries.zh: 其他人准备离开时，她虔诚地坐在小教堂的窗旁。

entries.en: He went to the bank to encash the cheque before paying the repair bill.
entries.zh: 他去银行兑现支票，然后再支付维修费。

entries.en: The committee voted to coopt a local architect to fill the vacant seat.
entries.zh: 委员会投票决定增补一位本地建筑师，填补那个空缺席位。

entries.en: The two puppies looked alike but differed behaviourally when strangers entered the room.
entries.zh: 这两只小狗看起来相似，但陌生人进屋时，它们在行为上表现不同。

entries.en: The fictional governor ruled repressively, closing newspapers that questioned his decisions.
entries.zh: 那位虚构的总督实行专制统治，关闭了质疑其决定的报纸。

entries.meaningZh: 由多种因素决定〔心理学〕
entries.en: In the psychologist's account, guilt and rivalry overdetermine the recurring dream.
entries.zh: 在那位心理学家的解释中，内疚和竞争共同决定了那个反复出现的梦。

entries.en: She ran her hand caressingly over the old dog's head as it fell asleep.
entries.zh: 老狗入睡时，她爱抚地用手抚过它的头。

entries.en: Don't faff around with the cushions; our guests are already at the door.
entries.zh: 别再为那些靠垫瞎忙了；客人已经到门口了。

entries.en: The analyst annualised the quarterly figures before comparing them with last year's total.
entries.zh: 分析员先把季度数字换算为全年数字，再与去年的总数比较。

entries.en: The singer laughed throatily when a paper flower fell from the microphone stand.
entries.zh: 一朵纸花从麦克风架上掉下来时，歌手发出了低沉沙哑的笑声。

entries.en: He pushed the unfinished puzzle aside and sighed frustratedly at the missing pieces.
entries.zh: 他把没拼完的拼图推到一边，对着那些缺失的拼块泄气地叹了口气。

entries.en: The diagram showed the dye covalently attached to the polymer rather than merely trapped inside it.
entries.zh: 图中显示，染料以共价方式连接在聚合物上，而不只是被包裹在其中。

entries.en: His apologies did not vail when the missing money was traced to his account.
entries.zh: 当失踪款项被追查到他的账户时，他的道歉也无济于事。

entries.en: The tool searches subfolders recursively but leaves hidden directories untouched.
entries.zh: 这个工具递归搜索子文件夹，但不会处理隐藏目录。

entries.en: The invented words differed phonologically even though their spellings were almost identical.
entries.zh: 这些自造词的拼写几乎相同，但在音系方面存在差异。

entries.en: The district remained agriculturally important even after the railway workshops closed.
entries.zh: 铁路机修厂关闭后，这个地区在农业方面依然很重要。

entries.en: The retired printer demonstrated the linotype to a small group of museum visitors.
entries.zh: 退休的印刷工向一小群博物馆参观者演示了整行铸造排字机。

entries.meaningZh: 把……打扮整齐；装扮〔俚语，常与 up 连用〕
entries.en: We hoped to spiff up the spare room before my parents arrived.
entries.zh: 我们希望在我父母到来前，把空房间收拾漂亮。

entries.en: A pigeon had shat on the clean washing hanging beside the balcony.
entries.zh: 一只鸽子在阳台旁晾着的干净衣物上拉了屎。

entries.en: The two restored recordings sounded indistinguishably alike through my small speakers.
entries.zh: 通过我的小音箱播放时，这两段修复后的录音听起来相似得无法分辨。

entries.en: She smiled embarrassedly after discovering that she had thanked the wrong person.
entries.zh: 发现自己谢错人后，她尴尬地笑了笑。

entries.en: The bakery offered to rehire him when its morning delivery route reopened.
entries.zh: 面包店重新开通早间送货路线后，提出要再次雇用他。

entries.en: He stirred the paint halfheartedly while watching the football match through the doorway.
entries.zh: 他一边透过门口看足球比赛，一边敷衍地搅着油漆。

entries.meaningZh: 使根深蒂固〔ingrain 的变体〕
entries.en: The daily warm-up helped engrain the new fingering pattern in her memory.
entries.zh: 每日的热身练习帮助她把新的指法模式牢牢记在脑中。

entries.en: She travelled adventurously, choosing the mountain route instead of the familiar coastal road.
entries.zh: 她旅行时勇于冒险，选择了山路，而不是熟悉的沿海道路。

entries.en: He spoke abrasively to the volunteers and then wondered why nobody returned.
entries.zh: 他对志愿者说话粗鲁，随后却奇怪为什么没有人再来。

entries.en: The brochure managed to misdescribe both the size and the location of our room.
entries.zh: 宣传册竟把我们房间的大小和位置都描述错了。

entries.en: The mechanic adjusted the shafts to intermesh the two gears smoothly.
entries.zh: 机修工调整了轴，以使两个齿轮顺畅地相互啮合。

entries.en: The witness answered elusively, discussing the weather instead of explaining his absence.
entries.zh: 证人巧妙地回避作答，谈起天气，却不解释自己为什么缺席。

entries.en: I sorta liked the green curtains, but not enough to buy them.
entries.zh: 我有点喜欢那些绿色窗帘，但还没喜欢到要把它们买下来。

entries.en: Losing our keys in the rain was the lowlight of an otherwise pleasant weekend.
entries.zh: 在雨中丢了钥匙，是那个原本愉快的周末中最糟心的时刻。

entries.en: We cannot sustainably run the workshop with only two volunteers and no regular funding.
entries.zh: 只有两名志愿者，又没有固定经费，我们无法把工作坊持续办下去。

entries.en: The wind carried the empty dinghy shorewards while we watched from the pier.
entries.zh: 我们在码头上望着，风把那艘空小艇吹向海岸。

entries.en: The owners agreed to demerge the printing business from the stationery shop.
entries.zh: 业主们同意把印刷业务从文具店拆分出去。

entries.en: We edged crabwise through the narrow gap without knocking over the stacked chairs.
entries.zh: 我们侧着身子挤过狭窄的空隙，没有碰倒堆叠着的椅子。

entries.meaningZh: 通过介绍来龙去脉使融入背景
entries.en: The curator used family letters to contextualize the portrait rather than discuss its colours alone.
entries.zh: 策展人利用家书介绍这幅肖像画的背景，而不只是讨论它的色彩。

entries.en: In the mock hearing, counsel asked the court to estop the claimant from denying the earlier agreement.
entries.zh: 模拟庭审中，律师请求法院运用禁止反言原则，阻止索赔人否认先前的协议。

entries.en: We compared the samples pairwise and recorded which pairs looked most alike.
entries.zh: 我们把样本两两比较，记录哪些配对看起来最相似。

entries.en: She relit the candle after a gust from the open window blew it out.
entries.zh: 一阵从开着的窗户吹进来的风把蜡烛吹灭后，她重新点燃了它。

entries.meaningZh: 恐惧的〔地区或非标准用语〕
entries.en: I was a-feared of the dark passage, but the dog went ahead without hesitation.
entries.zh: 我害怕那条黑暗的通道，但狗毫不犹豫地走在了前面。

entries.meaningZh: 激动的〔文学性连字符写法〕
entries.en: The children were a-flutter before the curtain rose on their first school play.
entries.zh: 第一次校园戏剧演出的幕布升起前，孩子们都激动不已。

entries.meaningZh: 丰富地；充裕地〔文学或非正式用语〕
entries.en: We laughed a-plenty while sorting through the ridiculous hats in the costume cupboard.
entries.zh: 我们整理戏服柜里那些可笑的帽子时，笑了个够。

entries.meaningZh: 让渡产权或财产〔法律，较少用词〕
entries.en: The fictional owner refuses to abalienate the orchard despite his creditors' demands.
entries.zh: 那位虚构的业主尽管受到债权人催逼，仍拒绝让渡果园。

entries.en: He lowered his hand abashedly when he realised everyone else had already understood the instructions.
entries.zh: 发现其他人都已经明白说明后，他羞愧地放下了手。

entries.meaningZh: 在舒适的温暖中〔较少用词〕
entries.en: The cat lay abask on the sunny windowsill, ignoring the toy rolling across the floor.
entries.zh: 猫暖洋洋地躺在有阳光的窗台上，对滚过地板的玩具毫不理会。

entries.en: During the acting lesson, he practised breathing abdominally while lying on a padded mat.
entries.zh: 表演课上，他躺在有衬垫的垫子上，练习用腹部呼吸。

entries.meaningZh: 忍受；容忍〔主要为方言，常用于 can 的否定式〕
entries.en: I can't abear the scraping noise that chair makes on the kitchen floor.
entries.zh: 我受不了那把椅子在厨房地板上发出的刮擦声。

entries.meaningZh: 无人问津地〔用于 go abegging，较少见〕
entries.en: Several free seats went abegging because the concert had been advertised at the wrong time.
entries.zh: 音乐会的宣传时间弄错了，因此几个免费座位无人问津。

entries.en: One sensor behaved aberrantly whenever we moved the cable near the metal frame.
entries.zh: 每当我们把电缆移到金属框架附近，一个传感器就表现异常。

entries.en: The landlord treated the frightened tenants abhorrently, laughing at their requests for repairs.
entries.zh: 房东以令人厌恶的方式对待那些惊恐的租户，嘲笑他们提出的维修请求。

entries.meaningZh: 常存〔古体第三人称单数形式〕
entries.en: Though the house is gone, her kindness abideth in the village's memory.
entries.zh: 虽然那座房子已不复存在，她的善良却常存于村民的记忆中。

entries.en: She remained abidingly grateful to the neighbour who had found her missing son.
entries.zh: 她始终感激那位找到了她失踪儿子的邻居。

entries.en: The researchers asked whether the compound could have formed abiotically in their model system.
entries.zh: 研究人员提出疑问：这种化合物是否可能在他们的模型系统中以非生物方式形成。

entries.en: Ablins the ferry will run tomorrow, if the wind drops overnight.
entries.zh: 如果风在夜里减弱，渡船明天也许会开航。

entries.en: The wind was already ablow when we carried the empty baskets down to the quay.
entries.zh: 我们把空篮子搬到码头时，风已经刮起来了。

entries.en: She was still ablush when the applause ended and the lights came back on.
entries.zh: 掌声结束、灯重新亮起时，她的脸还红着。

entries.en: The pot was aboil before I had finished chopping the vegetables.
entries.zh: 我还没切完蔬菜，锅里就沸腾起来了。

entries.meaningZh: 使信奉废奴主义〔美国历史用语〕
entries.en: In the historical drama, the pamphleteer hopes to abolitionize the town's influential merchants.
entries.zh: 在这部历史剧中，那位政论作者希望使镇上有影响力的商人信奉废奴主义。

entries.en: In the sketch, two dark bands extend aborally from the mouth.
entries.zh: 在这张草图上，两条深色条带从口部朝背离口的方向延伸。

entries.en: The house was aboriginally a single storey, before successive owners added the upper rooms.
entries.zh: 这座房子原来只有一层，后来历任房主增建了楼上的房间。

entries.meaningZh: 正在产生中的〔文学用语〕
entries.en: The still aborning proposal lost its funding when the sponsor withdrew.
entries.zh: 赞助方退出后，那项尚在酝酿中的提案失去了经费。

entries.meaningZh: 立场或观点的彻底改变〔复数〕
entries.en: His repeated about-faces on the library closure left the residents unsure what he supported.
entries.zh: 他在图书馆关闭问题上反复改变立场，让居民不清楚他究竟支持什么。

entries.en: The skipper decided to about-ship before the current carried us towards the rocks.
entries.zh: 船长决定在水流把我们推向礁石之前改变航向。

entries.en: A sudden about-turn brought him face to face with the person following him.
entries.zh: 他突然向后转，与跟在身后的人面对面了。

entries.en: They conducted the negotiations above-board, allowing both sides to inspect the same documents.
entries.zh: 他们光明正大地进行谈判，让双方都能查阅相同的文件。

entries.en: We stayed abovedeck until the rain forced us into the cramped cabin.
entries.zh: 我们一直待在甲板上，直到雨把我们逼进狭小的船舱。

entries.en: Someone was moving furniture abovestairs while I tried to sleep in the room below.
entries.zh: 我试图在下面的房间睡觉时，有人正在楼上搬家具。

entries.en: In the tale, the sleeping guard would abraid whenever the iron bell rang.
entries.zh: 故事中，每当铁钟响起，熟睡的守卫就会惊醒。

entries.en: The basin was abrim, and one more cup of water would spill over the edge.
entries.zh: 盆里已经满了，再倒一杯水就会溢出盆沿。

entries.en: The gardener paused to abscind the tangled vine before lifting the fallen gate.
entries.zh: 园丁停下来切断缠结的藤蔓，然后才抬起倒下的门。

entries.en: I absent-mindedly put the milk in the cupboard and the cereal in the fridge.
entries.zh: 我心不在焉地把牛奶放进橱柜，把麦片放进冰箱。

entries.en: The director warned us not to absolutize one audience member's opinion of the performance.
entries.zh: 导演提醒我们，不要把某一位观众对演出的看法绝对化。

entries.en: By absolutizing the deadline, the manager ignored the repairs needed for a safe reopening.
entries.zh: 经理把最后期限绝对化，忽视了安全重新开放所需的维修。

entries.en: He studied the miniature model absorbedly and failed to notice the tea going cold beside him.
entries.zh: 他全神贯注地研究那件微缩模型，没有注意到身旁的茶渐渐凉了。

entries.en: She told the story so absorbingly that we forgot to ask about dessert.
entries.zh: 她把故事讲得如此引人入胜，我们都忘了问甜点的事。

entries.en: She used a soft linen cloth to absterge the dust from the carving.
entries.zh: 她用柔软的亚麻布擦去了雕刻品上的灰尘。

entries.en: He treated the conflict abstractively, ignoring the actual neighbours caught in it.
entries.zh: 他抽象地处理这场冲突，忽视了实际卷入其中的邻居们。

entries.en: The watchman paused to accend his lantern before opening the heavy gate.
entries.zh: 守夜人先停下来点燃提灯，然后才打开那扇沉重的门。

entries.en: The emergency telephone was mounted accessibly beside the entrance rather than inside the locked office.
entries.zh: 应急电话安装在入口旁方便够到的位置，而不是锁着的办公室里。

entries.en: In the mock trial, the defendant was held accessorially liable for the burglary.
entries.zh: 模拟审判中，被告被判以从犯身份对那起入室盗窃承担责任。

entries.en: She accessorizes her plain work dresses with colourful scarves rather than expensive jewellery.
entries.zh: 她用色彩鲜艳的围巾，而不是昂贵的珠宝，为朴素的工作裙装作搭配。

entries.en: He was accessorizing the shop window's mannequin when the delivery van arrived.
entries.zh: 送货车到达时，他正在用配饰装饰橱窗里的模特人台。

entries.en: The king sent a messenger to accite the absent councillors before sunset.
entries.zh: 国王派出信使，要在日落前召来缺席的议事顾问。

entries.en: A missing score page interrupted our rehearsal of the accompagnato.
entries.zh: 缺了一页乐谱，使我们那段伴奏宣叙调的排练中断了。

entries.meaningZh: 一致地；调和地〔较少用词〕
entries.en: The two choirs sang accordantly despite having rehearsed in different towns.
entries.zh: 两个合唱团尽管在不同的城镇排练，合唱却很和谐。

entries.en: We accordion-folded the long paper strip so it would fit inside the small envelope.
entries.zh: 我们把长纸条折成手风琴式皱褶，好装进小信封。

entries.en: The village doctor was summoned to accouche the farmer's wife in the historical novel.
entries.zh: 在这部历史小说中，乡村医生被召去为农夫的妻子接生。
